text:
Maya: Okay real talk — who’s benching rookie RBs for the playoffs? Im torn.
Carlos: Im benching one for matchup reasons. Also offering a trade: my RB backup (R. Hale) for Mayas WR (T. Nguyen) + sourdough loaf.
Jen: Sourdough is a legal tender in this office. :bread:
Victor: Wait what? Were now doing food-backed trades? I want in.
Maya: How do we even enforce food trades across remote folks? Drop in kitchen if local, otherwise Venmo + photo proof.
Carlos: Photo proof accepted. Also Im serious about the trade — Hale has an easy set of matchups next week.
Maya: Hmm Id accept for the right loaf. But Im worried about bye weeks.
Jen: FYI per league rules, food trades require commissioner approval. :gavel:
Victor: @Jen are you commissioner or are you trying to be?
Jen: Official-ish. Ive got the key to the office fridge so thats my power move.
standings-bot: reminder: playoff seeding updated. Maya remains at 4 with tiebreakers.
Maya: Thanks standings-bot. Pressure is real.
Carlos: If Maya passes, I keep Hale and offer a half-loaf + kombucha to sweeten.
Maya: Kombucha negotiation tactics... impressive.
Jen: Can we have a quick poll: Allow non-monetary/food trade collateral?
poll-bot: poll created: "Allow food/kombucha collateral for trades?" options: Yes, No, Case-by-case. React with :thumbsup:, :thumbsdown:, :eyes:.
Victor: Voting now. Case-by-case feels right.
Maya: Also proposal: bench swap grace rule — if someone accidentally autopicks wrong, allow one emergency swap per season. Thoughts?
Jen: +1 for one emergency. But commish veto still applies.
Carlos: Fine but emergency swap must include offering a snack if the mistake cost someone a win. :laughing:
Victor: This office is officially barter-driven.
Maya: If we pass the poll, Ill accept the trade + half-loaf. Will ping Jen for final sign-off.
Jen: Ill officiate. Send the loaf receipt.
standings-bot: trade proposal recorded: Carlos -> Maya: R. Hale for T. Nguyen. Status: pending commish approval.
Maya: Thanks all. Also shoutout to @Jen for keeping the league sanity. :heart:
Carlos: May the snacks be ever in your favor.
Victor: Reminder: fantasy playoffs in 2 weeks. Keep your A-game and your snack budgets.
poll-bot: poll results (partial): Yes: 2, No: 1, Case-by-case: 3. Poll still active.
Maya: Closing for now — will update when Jen approves. No midnight autopicks unless bribed ethically. :wink:
